summary:
萬事達EPS大幅超預期12%，第四季支付旺季帶動獲利明顯優於市場預估。
• EPS 4.76美元，遠超預期4.24美元，超預期幅度達12.26%
• 營收88.1億美元，為本批最高季度營收，受惠假期旺季消費
• 獲利端展現營運槓桿，超預期幅度明顯放大
• 支付網路規模效應持續貢獻穩定現金流
ai_view:
訊號偏強：12%的EPS超預期幅度反映旺季消費與成本控管雙重貢獻，獲利品質佳。短期對股價偏正面，惟營收年增率未揭露，須留意是否為一次性因素拉抬。中期觀察萬事達能否將旺季動能延續至附加價值服務與新興市場。追蹤指標：交易筆數與金額年增、營業利潤率、回購力道，以及下一季營收年增是否維持雙位數。

需留意：本季營收年增率未揭露，難判斷成長基期效應；旺季高基期恐使後續季度成長相形放緩；監管與訴訟風險仍是長期不確定因素

summary_en:
Mastercard delivered a strong 12% EPS beat as peak-season payment activity boosted earnings.
• EPS of $4.76 strongly beat the $4.24 estimate, a 12.26% surprise
• Revenue of $8.81B, the highest quarterly figure in this batch, aided by holiday-season spending
• Operating leverage drove a notably wider earnings beat
• Network scale effects continue to generate stable cash flow

ai_view_en:
Signal is firm: the 12% EPS beat reflects peak-season spend and cost discipline, with solid earnings quality. Near-term positive for the stock, but with YoY revenue undisclosed, watch for one-off lifts. Mid-term, monitor whether Mastercard extends seasonal momentum into value-added services and emerging markets. Track: transaction count and value growth, operating margin, buyback pace, and whether next quarter's revenue growth stays double-digit.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed this quarter, limiting base-effect visibility; A high holiday-season base may make subsequent quarters look slower; Regulatory and litigation risk remains a long-term overhang
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期12.26%，季度獲利顯著優於預估（營收年增率未揭露）。
